definitions.gloss: the morning after an all-nighter; post-all-nighter state
definitions.explanation: The period immediately following a night spent without sleep, typically the next morning or day. Implies tiredness and exhaustion from staying up all night, whether for work, study, or other reasons.

examples.japanese: {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{頭|あたま}→頭：00574_atama⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ぼんやりする→ぼんやりする：21687_bonyarisuru⟧。
examples.english: My head is foggy after pulling an all-nighter.

examples.japanese: {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|で}なければ→出る：00513_deru⟧⟦ならなかった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I had to attend the meeting without having slept at all.

examples.japanese: {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{運転|うんてん}する→運転する：20318_untensuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{危険|きけん}→危険：01141_kiken⟧だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧、⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{仮眠|かみん}→仮眠：08333_kamin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Driving after an all-nighter is dangerous, so you should at least take a short nap.

notes:
USAGE:
{徹夜明|てつやあ}け is a compound of ⟦{徹夜|てつや}→徹夜：03552_tetsuya⟧ (all-nighter) and ⟦{明|あ}け→明け：13157_ake⟧ (the period after). It is used as a noun, often followed by で to indicate doing something in the post-all-nighter state. Common among students and workers.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ + verb (to do something after an all-nighter)
- {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧まま (still in the all-nighter aftermath)
- {徹夜明|てつやあ}け⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧ (a body exhausted from an all-nighter)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {徹夜明|てつやあ}け: state after staying up all night
- ⟦{徹夜|てつや}→徹夜：03552_tetsuya⟧: staying up all night (the act itself)
- ⟦{夜更|よふ}かし→夜更かし：07693_yofukashi⟧: staying up late (not necessarily all night)
- ⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧: lack of sleep (general sleep deprivation)
